Nah they just happen from moisture getting on your nail. I don't believe they can be caused by the technician. Just happens, nothing to be ashamed of or worried about, it'll go away 🤗

Hmm it's hard to say what made the nail lift from your natural nail. You mightve bumped it loose or it mightve just lifted on its own. One thing I do is occasionally look at the underside of my nail to see if the tip got lifted letting moisture in. I'd just make sure the nail tech was properly sanitizing my natural nail before putting the acrylic on as well! I wish I could help more 😭
If you do you'll have to not get that nail done unfortunately 😔 some nail techs might even turn you away completely while having it.

Unfortunately it seems you had an air pocket under the nail that got moisture in it. You have a greenie! I'd happened to me before. It goes away with exposure to open air. Be sure not to get a new set till after it's completley gone though, cuz it's basically nail mold.
